project.title: REPOSITORY Delivery
project.description: Illustrative delivery management for an existing or new repository. Reuse existing Project and milestones; add only justified work. No dates are approved.

milestones.title: M0 - Current priorities and evidence review (illustrative)
milestones.description: Use an existing milestone if it fits. This is a fictional review objective; don't create it unless an audit finds a real milestone gap.

milestones.title: M1 - Next meaningful delivery gate (illustrative)
milestones.description: A verified next release, maintenance increment or research objective, not a compulsory MVP. Omit this milestone if the repository has no matching deliverable.

issues.title: [EPIC] Reconcile current delivery and reliability evidence
issues.body:
## Outcome
Confirm what is already shipped, in progress, blocked and verified.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Review existing releases and issue/project records
- [ ] Confirm material reliability or delivery gaps with evidence
- [ ] Avoid recreating completed work

issues.title: Review current CI, tests and open regression gaps
issues.body:
## Outcome
Establish whether any missing evidence or test coverage blocks the next meaningful outcome.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Record actual tests and CI evidence
- [ ] Separate simulated from real-platform validation
- [ ] Reuse existing issues; open only genuinely missing work

issues.title: Review criteria for the next release or maintenance increment
issues.body:
## Outcome
Define the next justified completion gate without inventing an MVP.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Document actual target outcome and dependencies
- [ ] Record testable acceptance evidence
- [ ] Preserve existing release and milestone policy
